notes.title: Verison 1.0.1.5
notes.content:
- Fireball enemy was firing way to many projectiles in some computers. 
-A signal for the fire coming out of the lava to reduce the randomness of when they fire. 
-Fix the sound glitch when running into walls it would make a loud noise, so far it working on my end. 
-Adjust the levels after level 35 to reduce more of the randomness. 
-Levels above 35 also been adjusted to increase flow.

-------------------------

-Work on an option to use the sword in the level select once you craft the sword

notes.title: This was a big deal for me releasing my first game on Steam. Thank you!
notes.content:
It took lots of work but I love each moment of it. I see there is still improvements that I want to do. Your feedback as help build this game to become what it is. For example, the new level select is amazing to see. It shows in detail your best times for each levels and the medals for each level. I would like to include pro medals as well because I think that is a cool medal to show off. 
Thank you for believing in me from the start. 

Because it was ask before,
- the 1 metal is if you collected all the charge blue orbs in a level.
-the other red K.0. Medal is if you completed the level under 3 K.Os

-I would like to work on a future update with a pro K.O. Medal. By completing the level with 0 K.0s because that is the most impressive metal
